targetTexts.1: Better a dry morsel in quietness than a house full of feasting with strife.
targetTexts.2: A wise servant will rule over a disgraceful son and share his inheritance as one of the brothers.
targetTexts.3: A crucible for silver and a furnace for gold, but the LORD is the tester of hearts.
targetTexts.4: A wicked man listens to evil lips; a liar gives ear to a destructive tongue.
targetTexts.5: He who mocks the poor insults their Maker; whoever gloats over calamity will not go unpunished.
targetTexts.6: Grandchildren are the crown of the aged, and the glory of a son is his father.
targetTexts.7: Eloquent words are unfit for a fool; how much worse are lying lips to a ruler!
targetTexts.8: A bribe is a charm to its giver; wherever he turns, he succeeds.
targetTexts.9: Whoever conceals an offense promotes love, but he who brings it up separates friends.
targetTexts.10: A rebuke cuts into a man of discernment deeper than a hundred lashes cut into a fool.
targetTexts.11: An evil man seeks only rebellion; a cruel messenger will be sent against him.
targetTexts.12: It is better to meet a bear robbed of her cubs than a fool in his folly.
targetTexts.13: If anyone returns evil for good, evil will never leave his house.
targetTexts.14: To start a quarrel is to release a flood; so abandon the dispute before it breaks out.
targetTexts.15: Acquitting the guilty and condemning the righteous—both are detestable to the LORD.
targetTexts.16: Why should the fool have money in his hand with no intention of buying wisdom?
targetTexts.17: A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
targetTexts.18: A man lacking judgment strikes hands in pledge and puts up security for his neighbor.
targetTexts.19: He who loves transgression loves strife; he who builds his gate high invites destruction.
targetTexts.20: The one with a perverse heart finds no good, and he whose tongue is deceitful falls into trouble.
targetTexts.21: A man fathers a fool to his own grief; the father of a fool has no joy.
targetTexts.22: A joyful heart is good medicine, but a broken spirit dries up the bones.
targetTexts.23: A wicked man takes a covert bribe to subvert the course of justice.
targetTexts.24: Wisdom is the focus of the discerning, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.
targetTexts.25: A foolish son brings grief to his father and bitterness to her who bore him.
targetTexts.26: It is surely not good to punish the innocent or to flog a noble for his honesty.
targetTexts.27: A man of knowledge restrains his words, and a man of understanding maintains a calm spirit.
targetTexts.28: Even a fool is considered wise if he keeps silent, and discerning when he holds his tongue.
